extraction.Name: Mary Ivy Johnson—nee Livermont
extraction.Refused/Protested: while she did not protest against taking it, she would not have taken it until the end of the trust period, if she had been consulted about it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: she still owns it, and it has never been under mortgage
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: she has kept the taxes paid up on her land all these years
extraction.Occupation/Income: her husband supports her and the children by ranching; and that this is the only source of his revenue
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent and has good health; mother of four minor children, all of whom have good health; husband has good health; forced patent in fee issued for her 320 acre allotment and forwarded by mail; she never sold her land for any debts incurred prior to receiving the patent in fee; has never received any help from the County, State nor the United States Government; document reference: 222444. 22404/a; sworn April 9, 1929 | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Pine Ridge (Shannon County, South Dakota)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
